english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for feeling let down and for a tone, face, or silence that shows disappointment.
Use this when the dissatisfaction specifically comes from disappointment because expectations were not met.
Use this when the frustration is specifically disappointment that an outcome did not meet expectations.

examples.english: I’m really disappointed; after waiting so long, there’s still no news.
examples.traditional: 我真係好失望，等咗咁耐都冇消息。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 sat1 mong6 dang2 zo2 gam3 noi6 dou1 mou5 siu1 sik1

examples.english: I was dissatisfied because the restaurant promised a gift but did not give us one.
examples.traditional: 間餐廳話會送禮物，點知冇，我好失望。
examples.jyutping: gaan1 caan1 teng1 waa6 wui5 sung3 lai5 mat6 dim2 zi1 mou5 ngo5 hou2 sat1 mong6

examples.english: I’m really frustrated that I got such a low score on this exam.
examples.traditional: 今次考試得咁少分，我真係好失望。
examples.jyutping: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 dak1 gam3 siu2 fan1 ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 sat1 mong6
